baseline: 0789a74 (0.8.1-15) on the Jolla Phone 2026 (jp26) and the Pro1-X on mainline (the Prawn)
method: LLM agents under the author's direction, not independent review: five read-only code agents (startup, room list, timeline, core and bridge, memory and images), one measurement agent on both phones (/proc per thread, smaps, frame timing, dev hook and touch), timing markers (3b356b7), fixes by agents owning files (65fd3d6, 0.8.2-1), a second round on 0.8.2-1 and fixes (662ea8e, 0.8.2-2), a third round on 0.8.2-4 (7cded38). Code report ids are kept; measurement ids carry the round (m1. for 0.8.1-15, m2. for 0.8.2-1, m3. for 0.8.2-4); merged ids under 'merged'. See 2026-11-22-performance.md.

non_findings.what: Scrolling on the jp26 is smooth: almost every frame 11 ms at 90 Hz, render median 1 to 2 ms, polish at most 3 ms; the few long gaps are GUI-thread stalls outside polish, some of them the pauses between gestures (0.8.1-15). Round three (0.8.2-4, touch, in front): chat 12 flicks older at 87 fps, frames over 20 ms 0.4 %, none over 34 ms.
Chat scrolling on the Prawn is bound by the GPU and the compositor: swap 17 to 24 ms of a 24 to 29 ms frame, render 2 to 3 ms, unchanged by 0.8.2 (S1 of both measurement rounds).
cacheBuffer is already Theme.itemSizeMedium * 8 in SilicaListView, about six room rows above and below the screen; do not raise it before RL1 and RL5.
Each core event's JSON is parsed on the core's thread; the GUI thread gets a QVariantMap.
Qt 5.6 has no QML disk cache (it came in 5.8); QML compiles from source at every start, and QML_DISABLE_DISK_CACHE=1 set by firejail changes nothing.
No booster in the start chain (invoker, booster-generic, firejail twice, exec): tap to process 0.4 to 0.7 s on the jp26, 1.5 to 1.7 s on the Prawn, before Rustrx code runs.
The GStreamer registry is kept between starts (whitelisted into the sandbox).
Idle with nothing animating: 0.3 to 0.5 % of one core, 4 to 7 wakeups/s, the core's sync; no interval timers in the core.
The 11-18 fixes hold: two glibc arenas (M1), the low-memory SQLite pools (M2).
Sliding-sync room subscriptions are replaced on each open, not added; the SDK event cache shrinks closed rooms.
List and chat pictures are asynchronous with sourceSize; a GIF keeps one frame (cache: false); the pixmap cache keeps 2 MB unreferenced; no proxy models; RoomModel::data about 1 us.
The jp26 suspends with the display off; the Prawn (mainline) does not. Rustrx with the display off: 0.3 to 0.9 % of one core per wall second.
Pausing GIFs while the chat moves showed no measurable effect on the Prawn's chat (few GIFs in the room).
Room list live updates: the app's list matched a full refresh on both phones (rounds two and three).

dead_ends: Hardware H.264 encoders for Send smaller videos (4220011): droidvenc on hybris takes only camera frames, the V4L2 encoder on the mainline Prawn ignores the bitrate. Software WebM instead.
AnimatedImage ignores sourceSize in Qt 5.6: a GIF cannot be decoded smaller. Pausing while the chat moves is what was left (DEC2).
Avatar rounding A/B (layer, off, texture, provider) on the Prawn, n=1 each: all within noise, the edges alike. The Prawn's 8 rows cannot show the cost; no evidence yet.
GPU memory: Mali and DRM buffers show 0 kB in the process's RSS; not measured.
